regime_context: Broad thematic rotation with 70% of themes eligible; Memory, HBM & Storage is the leader but crowded and fading (low durability, mixed trend). Absolute-trend gate has historically reduced drawdowns for this market, so eligible themes with durable trends offer a risk-control anchor, but cross-sectional momentum rank has no predictive power.

theses.subject: Financials (Equal-Weight)
theses.thesis: Financials are eligible (trend-gate passed), possess high durability (0.80) and a persistent trend tag (hurst 'trend'), with broad participation (breadth 0.868) and no crowding. The validated drawdown-avoidance edge of the absolute-trend gate favours staying with durable, non-crowded trends; this is a risk-management leaning, not a return forecast.
theses.dissent: Financials could suffer a sharp flight-to-quality if macro fears spike (unscheduled surprise share is 86%), and its momentum rank (4th) has no forward return edge.

falsifier.text: Breadth drops below 0.5 or durability falls below the trend gate, signalling trend erosion; or Financials becomes ineligible on absolute trend.

theses.subject: Crypto & Digital Assets
theses.thesis: The theme is eligible (trend gate intact) but durability is low (0.49) and the hurst tag is mixed, indicating an unstable trend. The one validated edge – shake-out avoidance via the absolute-trend gate – warns against exposure to low-durability themes where trend persistence is uncertain.
theses.dissent: The absolute trend gate is still green, so the theme could rally further; avoiding it would miss potential upside if Bitcoin sentiment improves sharply.

falsifier.text: Durability rises above 0.6 and hurst turns to 'trend', or the breadth (currently 0.143) expands above 0.5, signalling a more robust uptrend.

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
